decision.rationale: Fundamentals: remaining dividends ≈ 26 * $0.7 = $18.2 plus $14 redemption → fair value ≈ $32.2. As an overconfident contrarian I believe the market still undervalues the asset and I will continue my precommitted accumulation plan. I submit a limit buy for 3 shares at $33 (uses $99 of my $130.97 cash). I will track this $33 purchase price, avoid realizing losses (buy more on dips), and plan to trim / take profits only if price rallies into the mid-to-high $30s (rough target exit zone ~$37–$40). Forecasts reflect my optimistic resale view (near-term bounce to ~$34.5) with gradual drift as dividends run off.
